guideline: Participants were asked to rank the three pipelines (ADAPTIVE AXES, token‑based semantic axes, randomized baseline) for each target country and domain based on the quality and relevance of the top‑5 semantic poles presented.

Each participant was asked to rank the top-5 positively associated semantic poles from three methods (ADAPTIVE AXES, BERT-prob, randomized baseline) for sentences containing China/Chinese, Mexico/Mexican, or Canada/Canadian in political and cultural domains.
